completion_credit.reason: A real grammar unit and a real two-column Spanish–Tarahumara prayer unit now traverse checksum verification, embedded-source extraction, independent facsimile OCR, canonical RHD validation and TEI export in CI. Full-witness processing and change-impact analysis remain required before the industrialization gate is closed.
